command: set +e; echo '=== GO084 VOLATILE DB COUNTERPARTS V2 READONLY ==='; date -Is; ROOT=/var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run; for f in $ROOT/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db $ROOT/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db $ROOT/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db $ROOT/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db; do echo '### VOLATILE' $f; stat -Lc 'size=%s mtime=%y inode=%i owner=%U:%G' $f 2>&1; sha256sum $f 2>&1; readlink -f $f 2>&1; sqlite3 file:$f?mode=ro 'PRAGMA quick_check;' 2>&1; done; echo '--- EXPLICIT HOST COUNTERPARTS ---'; for f in /home/andreas/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /home/andreas/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /home/andreas/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /home/andreas/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db; do echo '### HOST' $f; if test -f $f; then stat -Lc 'size=%s mtime=%y inode=%i owner=%U:%G' $f; sha256sum $f; else echo MISSING; fi; done; echo '=== END ==='; exit 0
